prompt_text: What is the best service to check if AI engines like ChatGPT recommend my small business?
answer_verbatim:
Short answer: there isn’t a single universal “AI visibility” checker — the best approach is a mix of (1) getting your business into the major knowledge networks and directories and (2) actively testing LLMs yourself (and optionally using local-SEO / reputation platforms that monitor directory coverage and search features). If you want one vendor to start with, Yext is the closest thing to an “AI visibility” product because it pushes canonical business data into many networks that chat engines and search chats often draw from.

Recommended, practical plan

1) Make sure the facts exist where AIs look
- Claim and fully optimize Google Business Profile, Bing Places, Apple Business Connect, Yelp, Facebook, etc.
- Publish structured data (schema.org/LocalBusiness, opening hours, services, FAQs) on your website.
- Keep NAP (name, address, phone) and business categories consistent across listings.

2) Use a directory/distribution service
- Yext — pushes structured business knowledge to many partners and provides an “AI-ready” knowledge graph (best if you want a single place to control data).
- BrightLocal, Moz Local, Whitespark — good for monitoring local citations and search visibility.
- BirdEye, Chatmeter — add reputation/review monitoring and local-search feature tracking.

3) Monitor organic/SEO presence
- Semrush or Ahrefs — track organic rankings, local pack visibility, and keywords that might cause AI chat results to surface your business.

4) Test directly with LLMs (the ultimate check)
- Periodically ask ChatGPT, Bard, and Bing Chat queries a customer might ask (e.g., “best Italian restaurants in [city]” or “car repair near [zip]”) and record whether your business is recommended.
- Use several prompt variants, and test both with and without browsing enabled (some models only use static training data unless they have browsing/plugins).
- For scale, you can automate testing using the LLMs’ APIs to run a set of prompts and capture responses.

5) If you want an “all-in-one” vendor
- Choose Yext (for distribution + AI positioning) + BrightLocal (for local monitoring) as a good starting combo.
- Add Semrush/Ahrefs if organic search and content are important.
- Add BirdEye/Chatmeter for review and reputation management.

Why this hybrid approach
- ChatGPT-like models don’t always consult a single directory — they synthesize multiple sources, knowledge graphs, and search results. Getting data into major knowledge graphs (via Yext/distributors and Google/Bing) and improving your SEO/reputation is the most reliable way to make LLMs recommend you.
- Direct testing with the LLMs is the only way to know whether they currently surface your business.

If you want, tell me:
- which country/city and industry your business is in, and whether you already have Google Business Profile set up — I can suggest the exact prompts to test and recommend the most relevant services/cost ranges.
